target.statement: ProCE (Gau Regularization) achieves 76.80 F1 on ACE 2005 Event Detection, compared to 70.87 F1 for DMBERT.

compute.basis: Estimate assumes reimplementing the full ProCE framework (BERT-base fine-tuning with Gaussian bias, recoupling, and Wasserstein regularization) from scratch on ACE 2005, which requires a GPU for reasonable training time and access to the LDC-licensed dataset.

blockers: No code or model weights released
ACE 2005 dataset requires LDC license and is not freely downloadable
Requires reimplementing complex probabilistic bias, recoupling, and Wasserstein regularization from scratch
Training BERT-base on ACE 2005 is slow on CPU; GPU strongly recommended
title: Recouple Event Field via Probabilistic Bias for Event Extraction
